spans.s:
m. (-न्दः)
A clock or plate on which hours are struck.
n. (-न्दं)
A pair, a couple, (male and female especially): see the next.

n. (-न्द्वं)
1 A pair, a brace.
2 A couple of animals, or male and female.
3 Union of the sexes or coupling.
4 Strife, dispute.
5 A secret.
m. (-न्द्वः)
1 A form of grammatical combination uniting two or more words in the same case, properly separated by a conjunction, as रामलक्ष्मणौ RĀMA and LAKṢMAṆA; पाणिपादं hand and foot.
2 A sign of the zodiac, (Gemini.)
3 A species of disease, a complication of two disorders, or compound affection of two humours.
E.
द्वि two, reduplicate, deriv. irr.

m. (-रः)
The ruddy goose.
E.
द्वग्द्व a couple, and चर who goes; flying in couples.

m. (-री)
The ruddy goose.
E.
द्वन्द्व, and चर to go, affix णिनिः see the last.

mfn. (-जः-जा-लं)
1 Produced or proceeding from morbid affection of two humours.
2 Proceeding from a pair, &c.
E.
द्वन्द्व, and ज born.

n. (-खं)
Pain arising from alternation, as of heat or cold, pleasure or pain, &c.
E.
द्वन्द्व, and दुःख pain.

n. (-न्नं)
Separation of the sexes.
E.
द्वन्द्व, and भिन्न broken.

n. (-द्धं)
Single combat.
E.
द्वन्द्व, and युद्ध war.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Free from worldly affections.
E.
द्वन्द्व alternation. (of pain and pleasure, &c.) and अतीत passed.

n. (-यः-यं)
A pair, a couple, two, chiefly used in composition, as पुरुषद्वयं two men.
E.
द्वि two, टयप् aff.

m. (-ग्निः)
A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.)

m. (-गः)
A saint, a holy or virtuous man.
E.
द्वय a pair, the two bad qualities, passion and ignorance, अति beyond, and ग who goes.

m. (-स्थः)
1 A warder, a porter.
2 NANDĪ, one of ŚIVA'S doorkeepers.
E.
द्वार् a door, and स्थ who stays; also द्वास्थ.

m. (-तः)
A doorkeeper, a warder.
E.
द्वार् a door, and स्थित staying; also द्वास्थित.

m. (-कः)
A warder, a porter, a chamberlain.
E.
द्वार् a door, स्थित staying, and दर्शक who shows, who introduces to the prince or great man to whom the mansion belongs; also द्वाःस्थित and दर्शक severally; also द्वाःस्थितदर्शिन्, m. (-र्शी)

m. (-री)
A book or composition.
E.
द्वात्रिंशत thirty-two, अक्षर a letter, a consonant, इनि affix; formed of thirty-two letters.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Having thirty-two auspicious marks, illustrious, great.
E.
द्वात्रिंशत् thirty-two, लक्षण a mark, उपेत possessing, endowed with.

mfn. (-शः-शी)
Twelfth.
f. (-शी)
The twelfth day of the half month.
E.
द्वादशन्, and टच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Consisting of twelve, amounting to twelve, &c.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-रः)
1 A name of VṚ

HASPATI.
2

A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
द्वादश twelve, and कर a hand or ray.

mfn. plu. (-श)
Twelve.
E.
द्वा for द्वि two, and दशन् ten.

n. (-कं)
A particular religious observance.
E.
द्वादश, and पत्र leaf or part, कन् added.

m. (-नः)
The god KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
द्वादश twelve, and लोचन an eye; the twelve-eyed, or six-headed deity.

m. (-शुः)
The deity VṚHASPATI, or planet Jupiter, over which he presides.
E.
द्वादश twelve, and अंशु a ray.

m. (-क्षः)
1 The god

KĀRTTIKEYA.
2

The deity or sage Buddha.
E.
द्वादश twelve, and अक्ष an eye: the word is sometimes read in the second sense, द्वादशाख्य m. (-ख्यः) the twelve-named.

n. (-न्त्रं)
A prayer of twelve syllables, especially as addressed to VIṢṆU, or Om, BHAGAVATE, VĀSUDEVĀYA, RĀMĀYA.
E.
द्वादश, अक्षर a letter, and मन्त्र formula.

m. (-लः)
A measure of twelve fingers.
E.
द्वादश, and अङ्गुल a finger.

m. (-त्मा)
The sun.
E.
द्वादश twelve, and आत्मन्, identity; being represented in and identified with the twelve Ādityas, or the sun in each month of the year; also द्वादशात्मक.

m. (-युः)
A dog.
E.
द्वादश twelve, (years,) and आयुस् life.

m. (-र्च्चिः)
VṚHASPATI, regent of Jupiter, and preceptor of the gods.
E.
द्वादश twelve, and अर्च्चिस् a ray of light.

nf. (-स्रं-स्री)
A parallelopipedon, a dodecagonal figure.
E.
द्वादश, and अस्र an angle.

m. (-रः)
1 The third of the four Yugas or great periods, comprising 864,000 years.
2 The age personified as a god.
3 Doubt, uncertainty.
E.
द्वा for द्वि two, पर after.

f. (-द्वाः)
1 A door, a gate.
2 A means, an expedient, a medium or way by which any thing takes place or is effected.
E.
द्वृ to cover or hold, in the causal form, affix विच.

n. (-रं)
1 A door, a gate, or rather the door or gateway, a passage, an entrance.
2 A way, a means, a medium or vehicle.
E.
द्वृ to cover, affix अच्.

mf. (-कः-का)
Dvāraka the capital of KṚṢṆA, supposed to have been submerged by the sea, but represented by a small island off the north part of the Malabar coast.
E.
द्वार a way, (to salvation,) affix कन्; also द्वारिका, द्वारवती, &c.

m. (-कः)
A door, a gate, the door itself.
E.
द्वार a doorway, and कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-शः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
द्वारका as above, and ईश master.

m. (-लः)
A warder, a doorkeeper.
E.
द्वार a door, and पाल who protects; also with कन् added द्वारपालक, or with the radical finals dropped द्वारप.

f. (-ण्डी)
The threshold of a door.
E.
द्वार a door, and पिण्ड a ball.

n. (-न्त्रं)
A lock, a bolt.
E.
द्वार a door, and यन्त्र an instrument.

f. (-ती)
The city Dvārakā.
E.
द्वार a door, and मतुप् poss. affix; also द्वारावती.

f. (-ती)
Dvāraka: see द्वारवती, &c.

m. (-भुक)
The Vaka, a sort of crane, (Ardea nivea).
E.
द्वार a door, वलि offal or fragments, and भुज् who eats.

f. (-खा)
The leaf of a door.
E.
द्वार a door, and शास्वा a branch.

m. (-म्भः)
A door-post.
E.
द्वार, and स्तम्भ a post.

m. (-स्थः)
A doorkeeper.
E.
द्वार a gate, and स्थ who stays.

m. (-कः)
A doorkeeper, a warder.
E.
द्वार a door, and ठक् affix.
f. (-का)
Dvāraka, KṚṢṆA'S capital: see द्वारक.
E.
द्वार, and ठन् aff.

m. (-री)
A porter, a warder, a doorkeeper.
E.
द्वार, and इनि aff.

m. (-स्थः)
A doorkeeper, a warder.
E.
द्वार a door, स्थ who stays, and र rejected; also र being changed to Visarga, द्वाःस्थ.

m. (-तः)
A doorkeeper.
E.
द्वार, and स्थित who stays; also द्वाःस्थितः see the last.

m. (-कः)
A doorkeeper: see द्वाःस्थितदर्शक, &c.
